node.title: Re^3: Parsing output with a special format
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
my $test_output = system($cmd);

That won't work, since [doc://system] returns the exit code and does not capture the command's output. I would recommend capture or capturex from [mod://IPC::System::Simple], which can give you an array of lines (my @lines = capture($cmd);). Otherwise, e.g. if the command's output is too large to be captured all at once, you could use a piped [doc://open], as I showed [id://1180578|here] along with other possible solutions.
